notes: Skateboarding matches no genre in the index, so the one clarifying question was the right move and its answer - a free-skate sandbox with no race and no scoring - lands on Simulation. I read Sports first because physics-based athletics is its remit, and rejected it: every one of its presets is built on scoring planes, foul perimeters and play-start positions, all of which the answers explicitly rule out. Shape is space-bounded, taken from the catalogue rather than Simulation's typical list, because a compact concrete plaza of flatground is one clearly bounded single-level space and the answers rule out a roamable open world; it routes P0, and the tilt steering and portrait framing are control choices with no layout consequence. Decided without a user: the prompt asks for empty ground for now and defers ramps and grinds, so I emitted no options and no preset rather than dressing the plaza - the ramps and rails become physics-rig on a later pass, and that is the one thing this build is knowingly holding back.
